question: akatsuki-ai CON-5 row 7 (HA#450 OQ-11): an agent run may merge its own sub-PRs into that run's integration branch (never main) under the maintainer's explicit grant. Ratify it as written?

options.label: Ratify (Recommended)
options.consequence: An agent run merges its own sub-PRs into its integration branch under the maintainer's grant; main stays the maintainer's

options.label: Amend
options.consequence: Sub-PR merges into an integration branch also need the maintainer's hand
